title: Finite-Horizon Reversible Investment under Multi-Factor Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2609.36405v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study a finite-horizon reversible investment problem in which a risk-neutral firm adjusts capacity at a proportional purchase cost and a lower salvage value under multi-factor geometric Brownian motion. Via the singular control--optimal switching correspondence, the marginal value of capacity solves a family of parabolic double-obstacle problems. We prove existence, uniqueness and local Sobolev regularity of the strong solution, characterize investment, waiting and disinvestment regions by continuous, strictly separated free boundaries, and verify optimality of the reflected capacity process. Numerically, joint demand improvements shift both boundaries super-additively, 1.5--2.7 times as strongly at the disinvestment boundary, depending on factor correlation.

translated_title: 多因子动态下的有限期可逆投资问题
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个有限期可逆投资问题，其中风险中性的企业在多因子几何布朗运动下，以比例购买成本和较低的残值来调整产能。通过奇异控制与最优切换之间的对应关系，产能的边际价值求解一族抛物型双障碍问题。我们证明了强解的存在性、唯一性和局部Sobolev正则性，用连续且严格分离的自由边界刻画了投资区、等待区和撤资区，并验证了反射产能过程的最优性。数值结果表明，联合需求改善会以超加性的方式移动两条边界，在撤资边界处的移动强度达1.5至2.7倍，具体大小取决于因子间的相关性。
tldr: 该论文在多因子几何布朗运动框架下研究有限期可逆投资问题，借助奇异控制与最优切换的对应关系证明产能边际价值所满足的抛物型双障碍问题强解的存在性、唯一性与正则性，刻画了投资与撤资的自由边界，并数值发现联合需求改善对边界移动具有超加性效应。
en_tdlr: This paper solves a finite-horizon reversible investment problem under multi-factor geometric Brownian motion via the singular control–optimal switching correspondence, proving existence, uniqueness and Sobolev regularity of the capacity's marginal value with strictly separated free boundaries, and numerically showing that joint demand improvements shift the investment and disinvestment boundaries super-additively.
